sources.title: MedCodER: A Generative AI Assistant for Medical Coding
sources.snippet: Recent advancements in Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) offer promising solutions to these challenges. In this work, we introduce MedCodER, a Generative AI framework for automatic medical coding that leverages extraction, retrieval, and re-ranking techniques as core components.
